items.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin Hold Historic Trilateral Summit in China
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin held their first-ever joint trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday. The three leaders signed a global declaration addressing nuclear risk reduction, energy security, and international cooperation.

items.headline: Anthropic Makes Wall Street History as First Frontier AI Developer to Go Public
items.summary: AI developer Anthropic officially began trading on the Nasdaq exchange on November 19, making history as the first frontier artificial intelligence company to go public. The landmark debut saw shares open well above the initial offering price before paring gains, serving as a major test of Wall Street's long-term faith in the AI boom.

items.headline: Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton Reach ATP Finals Semifinals in Turin
items.summary: Top-seeded Alexander Zverev completed an undefeated group stage at the ATP Finals in Turin by defeating Arthur Fils in straight sets on Thursday. American Ben Shelton also secured his spot in the season-ending semifinals for the first time after earning a victory over Rafael Jodar.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Launches Worldwide to Record Review Scores After 13-Year Wait
items.summary: Rockstar Games officially released Grand Theft Auto VI worldwide on November 19, marking the franchise's first flagship entry in thirteen years. The open-world action title debuted to critical acclaim, achieving a record-tying 99 score on review aggregator Metacritic and sparking massive global excitement.
